title: Passive Voice: They Say and They Believe — Quiz 109
content:
## Passive Voice: They Say and They Believe

Practise reporting a general belief using passive constructions.

### Lesson focus

1. They say that a laugh a day improves our health.
2. They believe that an apple a day keeps the doctor away.
3. People say that Padmavati was very beautiful.

### Understand the pattern

Match the infinitive to the time of the reported action. Use to be or another simple infinitive for a situation simultaneous with the reporting belief. Use to have been or another perfect infinitive for an earlier situation.

### Worked answers and explanation

They say that a laugh a day improves our health → It is said that a laugh a day improves our health; a laugh a day is said to improve our health. People say that Padmavati was very beautiful → Padmavati is said to have been very beautiful. The second claim concerns an earlier time.

### Try another

Rewrite: People believe that the writer lived here.

### Suggested answer

The writer is believed to have lived here. To have lived marks the residence as earlier than the current belief.
